title: Octane — React's programming model, compiled
excerpt: React's programming model, compiled ahead of time. No VDOM, no rules of hooks.
content_html:
The successor to Inferno, built around the same focus on performance. It brings React’s hooks, Suspense, and actions to a compiler-first architecture. No virtual DOM, rules of hooks, or dependency arrays you have to maintain yourself. The compiler tracks what your code uses automatically.

Get started Differences from React

Counter.tsrx

// Counter.tsrx — hooks next to output, no rules of hooks
import { useState, useEffect } from 'octane';

export function Counter(props) @{
	const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

	// A hook behind a condition is fine — slots are
	// assigned by call site, not call order.
	if (!props.paused) {
		useEffect(() => {
			console.log('count is now', count);
		}); // the compiler infers [count]
	}

	<button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>{'Count: ' + count}</button>
}

Live

// count is now 0

No rules of hooks

Forget dependency arrays and rigid hook rules. The compiler tracks what your effects, memos, and callbacks use automatically, so hooks can safely live inside conditions or after early returns.

Parallel async

Independent use() calls start at the same time instead of suspending one by one. Nested fetches begin earlier, and streaming SSR sends each boundary as soon as it’s ready.

No virtual DOM

Templates compile to cloned DOM nodes with direct updates. The keyed lists move only the nodes they need to. You can still use .tsx components and move to .tsrx one component at a time.

Still feels familiar

You still get hooks, memo, context, portals, transitions, actions, controlled forms and Suspense. Events use the DOM, refs are regular props, and 53 first-party bindings cover familiar libraries.

11,500+test executions across the compiler, runtime, SSR and bindings. This count includes reruns in different compiler modes. The core suite has 3,900+ distinct cases. React-derived coverage is tracked case by case.

0 rules of hooks. Put hooks behind conditions or after an early return.

53first-party ecosystem bindings for state, data, routing, UI, forms, charts, 3D, and more

Your app should feel fast. Your code should still feel familiar.

What does moving a React app to Octane look like?

An Octane component is still a plain function with props, hooks and context. State lives where you expect it to, and data still flows from parent to child. If you know React, most of Octane will already make sense.

Keep your existing TSX and convert components to TSRX as you go. The component model stays the same, so the migration does not require a redesign. The work is easy to review, whether you do it by hand or with a coding agent.

Why not build Octane on signals?

Signals are useful, and you can use them in an Octane app when they fit. Octane does not make them the foundation because that would change how every component reads state. Components stay as plain functions that run from top to bottom. The compiler handles the bookkeeping.

The benchmarks show the trade-off. Signal-based frameworks lead in workloads designed around signals. Across the suites below, Octane stays competitive without changing the way you structure components. See what TSRX adds →

Add Octane to a React app. One component at a time.

OctaneCompat lets a React 19 app render compiled Octane components. Events inside each island stay native and delegated. Octane components can read your React context with use(), and they render on the server and hydrate in the browser. You can migrate one component at a time instead of rewriting the app.

React Server Components are the one exception. Hooks, Suspense, context and SSR carry over.

See how OctaneCompat works →

App.tsx

// App.tsx — your existing React 19 app
import { OctaneCompat } from 'octane/react';
import { Counter } from './islands/Counter.tsrx';

export function App() {
	return (
		<div className="dashboard">
			<h1>Ported one component at a time</h1>

			{/* A compiled Octane island, hosted inside React with typed
			    props. Native events, real React context, SSR + hydration. */}
			<OctaneCompat>
				<Counter start={3} />
			</OctaneCompat>
		</div>
	);
}

content_html_zh:
Inferno 的继任者，同样注重性能。 它将 React 的 hooks、Suspense 和 actions 引入了编译器优先的架构。 无需您自己维护虚拟 DOM、挂钩规则或依赖项数组。 编译器会自动跟踪您的代码使用的内容。

开始使用 与 React 的区别

计数器.tsrx

// Counter.tsrx — hooks next to output, no rules of hooks
import { useState, useEffect } from 'octane';

export function Counter(props) @{
	const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

	// A hook behind a condition is fine — slots are
	// assigned by call site, not call order.
	if (!props.paused) {
		useEffect(() => {
			console.log('count is now', count);
		}); // the compiler infers [count]
	}

	<button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>{'Count: ' + count}</button>
}

Live

暂停//计数现在为 0

没有钩子规则

忘记依赖数组和严格的钩子规则。 编译器会自动跟踪您的效果、备忘录和回调使用的内容，因此挂钩可以安全地存在于条件内或早期返回之后。

并行异步

独立的 use() 调用同时启动，而不是一一挂起。 嵌套获取会更早开始，流式 SSR 会在准备好后立即发送每个边界。

没有虚拟 DOM

模板编译为克隆的 DOM 节点并直接更新。 键控列表仅移动它们需要的节点。 您仍然可以使用 .tsx 组件并一次移至 .tsrx 一个组件。

还是感觉很熟悉

您仍然可以获得挂钩、备忘录、上下文、门户、过渡、动作、受控形式和悬念。 事件使用 DOM，refs 是常规 props，53 个第一方绑定涵盖了熟悉的库。

跨编译器、运行时、SSR 和绑定的 11,500 多次测试执行。 此计数包括不同编译器模式下的重新运行。 核心套件有 3,900 多个不同的案例。 React 衍生的覆盖范围是逐个跟踪的。

0 条钩子规则。 将钩子放在条件后面或提前返回之后。

53 个第一方生态系统绑定，用于状态、数据、路由、UI、表单、图表、3D 等

您的应用程序应该感觉很快。 您的代码应该仍然很熟悉。

将 React 应用程序迁移到 Octane 是什么样子？

Octane 组件仍然是一个带有 props、hooks 和 context 的普通函数。 状态位于您期望的位置，并且数据仍然从父级流向子级。 如果你了解 React，那么 Octane 的大部分内容就已经有意义了。

保留现有的 TSX 并将组件转换为 TSRX。 组件模型保持不变，因此迁移不需要重新设计。 无论您是手工完成还是通过编码代理完成，这项工作都很容易检查。

为什么不在信号上构建 Octane？

信号很有用，您可以在合适的时候在 Octane 应用程序中使用它们。 Octane 并不使它们成为基础，因为这会改变每个组件读取状态的方式。 组件保持为从上到下运行的简单函数。 编译器负责簿记。

基准显示了权衡。 基于信号的框架导致围绕信号设计的工作负载。 在以下套件中，Octane 保持竞争力，而无需改变构建组件的方式。 查看 TSRX 添加了哪些内容 →

将 Octane 添加到 React 应用程序中。 一次一个组件。

OctaneCompat 让 React 19 应用程序渲染已编译的 Octane 组件。 每个岛屿内的活动都保持本地化和委托化。 Octane 组件可以使用 use() 读取您的 React 上下文，它们在服务器上渲染并在浏览器中进行水化。 您可以一次迁移一个组件，而无需重写应用程序。

React 服务器组件是一个例外。 引人入胜、悬念、背景和 SSR 得以延续。

See how OctaneCompat works →

应用程序.tsx

// App.tsx — your existing React 19 app
import { OctaneCompat } from 'octane/react';
import { Counter } from './islands/Counter.tsrx';

export function App() {
	return (
		<div className="dashboard">
			<h1>Ported one component at a time</h1>

			{/* A compiled Octane island, hosted inside React with typed
			    props. Native events, real React context, SSR + hydration. */}
			<OctaneCompat>
				<Counter start={3} />
			</OctaneCompat>
		</div>
	);
}

Three.js，在 Octane 上。

这个火焰是由 @octanejs/third 渲染的实时 Three.js 场景，@octanejs/ Three 是 React Three Fiber 的技术预览端口。 仅当您滚动到它附近时才会加载。 拖动它使其旋转。
